killedBy: classifyPad: the four verdicts refuses a pad no catalogue entry matches, and says what the browser reported
createGamepadReader: move (left stick) tolerates a pad reporting fewer than 4 axes, and reads NOTHING off it
why: Restores the exact behaviour issue #596 was filed against: a pad the browser did not remap, and this catalogue does not recognize, read with the standard mapping's indices anyway. It is not a lesser version of working -- axis 0 of an unknown device is not 'the left stick, roughly', and button 7 is not 'fire, roughly'. The game cannot distinguish the input it invents this way from a player's own hands, which is why the refusal is the feature. Two tests kill it from opposite ends: the classifier's own verdict, and the reader proving a refused pad moves nothing while still reporting as connected.
